question: does swapping the caption tower move within and cross by the same factor
credit: test proposed by Dipankar Sarkar; spread requirement his too

supersedes.why: that version used ONE shared swapped encoder, so the swapped side lost its dependence on the text vendor and swapped-within and swapped-cross estimated the same quantity (0.0835 vs 0.0833). The ratio test collapsed to cross_native / within_native. Not underpowered, degenerate.
